title: TokenEconomizer — Experience-Driven Cost Control for Coding Agents
resourceType: Open-source Coding Agent plugin / repository-specific learned cost optimization and failure-loop guard
purpose: 不修改模型或 Coding Agent 核心，而是在多次開發 Session 之間學習 Repository-specific 經驗，透過 Micro-skills 保存可驗證的環境知識、Tool Pruning 移除長期未使用的工具定義，以及 Failure-loop Intervention 偵測重複失敗並提醒改變策略，降低不必要的 Token 與模型呼叫成本。
recommendation: 適合重複在同一個 Repo 使用 Claude Code、Codex、GitHub Copilot CLI 或 Pi 的 Coding Agent 開發；可先以唯讀評估、個別功能開關與 toolprune=propose 觀察實際工具裁剪提案，對照啟用前後的成本、工具可用性及任務成功率。微技能由舊 Session 學來，可能過時或帶有不可信輸出；需審查證據與權限。若既有 Harness 已用 Claude-Mem、Skills、Hooks、MCP 或其他 Tool 過濾器，先檢查注入、Hook、設定檔與工具停用是否衝突，再決定是否採用。
version: 0.1.0 (pyproject.toml; repository package metadata, not a separately verified released binary)

mechanisms.name: Micro-skills: repository environment facts
mechanisms.behavior: 從重複錯誤及週期性 Model Proposal 學得 Repo-specific 命令與環境事實；通常須三次 Session 確認後注入 SessionStart，若新觀察反駁則移除。microskills=envfacts 可只用失敗經驗、不額外呼叫 Proposer；完整模式會使用模型及產生相關成本。
mechanisms.tradeoffs: 若訓練來源遭污染、專案環境變更或記憶不合時宜，可能把不正確指令當作經驗重新帶入 Context；微技能是自動學得的 Facts，並非上游提供獨立可下載的 SKILL.md。

mechanisms.name: Tool Pruning: remove unused tool definitions
mechanisms.behavior: 依多個 Session／Prompt 的工具使用證據移除長期未被使用的工具定義；寫入各 Agent 的專案本機設定，後續 Session 才生效。toolprune=propose 僅提出清單，須人工 apply；restore 可撤銷已加的 deny 規則。
mechanisms.tradeoffs: 不同 Host 能關閉的單位不同：Claude Code 可精簡個別工具；Codex 為 capability packages；Copilot CLI 為完整 MCP Servers；Pi 和 opencode 不執行工具裁剪。停用能力可能影響後續罕見任務，應檢查提案、追蹤品質並可回復。

mechanisms.name: Failure-loop intervention
mechanisms.behavior: 依已成功結束的 Turn 建立行為長度基準；偵測反覆失敗或長時間沒有進展時，以 Judge／Redirect 提醒 Agent 改變策略，預設信心門檻 0.7 且每 Turn 最多一次提醒；仍持續卡住則提示使用者如何中斷。
mechanisms.tradeoffs: 互動式 Plugin 不會自動終止 Agent Turn；Judge 與 Redirect 可能產生模型額外花費，且 Judge 判斷不保證完美；實驗 Harness 的終止行為不能等同日常 Plugin 的效果。

compatibility.languages: Python 3.10+ on PATH; main Python package is standard-library only.
compatibility.versionCaveat: 以上是 README 列出的已測試版本範圍，不表示更高版本一定相容；實際安裝需先檢查目前 Host／Plugin API 的 Hook 信任及配置差異。

benchmarkEvidence.provenance: Official GitHub README cites research paper arXiv:2610.22732 and experiments/README.md. Measurements were not independently rerun by this collection.
benchmarkEvidence.benchmark: 277 SWE-Bench tasks from six repositories; five agent–model combinations and 30 repository×combination cells; comparison includes the plugin's own model-call costs.
benchmarkEvidence.reportedResult: 18.4–30.9% lower mean cost across five agent–model combinations; cheaper in 30/30 repository × combination cells; Pass@1 improved in four out of five combinations.
benchmarkEvidence.supplementaryClaims: README reports 16–21% lower cost on Web-Bench and 6–20% on two security-auditing benchmarks; other datasets, model versions, pricing, tasks and hardware can produce different results.
benchmarkEvidence.reproducibility: Upstream includes experiments/ and workloads; experiment harness requires specific agent CLIs, keys and a Docker evaluation environment. No experiments or third-party code executed here.

securityAndOperations.localState: Repo-specific agent observations, learned facts, cost ledger, error logs and configuration reside under ~/.tokeneconomizer; plugin may also update repository-local agent settings files.
securityAndOperations.fileWrites: Tool pruning writes Claude Code .claude/settings.local.json, Codex .codex/config.toml or Copilot .github/copilot/settings.local.json where safe; original user-defined deny rules are intended to remain untouched. Verify Git/worktree boundaries, config diffs and rollback before enabling.
securityAndOperations.hookPermissions: Installation changes the agent Plugin／Hook execution path and asks user to trust hooks and repository folders. Only review code; do not treat an upstream install instruction as authorization to execute it.
securityAndOperations.modelAndNetwork: Project states that it needs no dedicated API Key; proposer and loop-guard Judge call models via the logged-in Agent and can consume plan quota. Session contents may be sent to that Agent's configured provider as part of these calls. No claim of a full offline or audited privacy boundary.
securityAndOperations.learnedInstructions: Repository-supplied tool outputs and old Session text can influence micro-skills; require trusted source, avoid storing credentials, compare outdated commands against current repo, and inspect any unintended prompt or hook changes.
securityAndOperations.behaviorLimits: Hooks fail open per upstream docs, so optimization failure should not block the normal session, but it also means the plugin is not a security guardrail or guaranteed loop stop.

distinctionFromOtherResources: RTK 主要減少終端／CLI 回傳內容；Claude-Mem 主要保存並檢索跨 Session 記憶；TokenEconomizer 主要降低跨 Session 重複學習、閒置工具 Schema 與失敗迴圈的執行成本。可能互補但功能與狀態擷取重疊，整合效果尚未實測。
notes: 2026-10-31 官方 main README、pyproject.toml、package.json、docs/ARCHITECTURE.md、docs/PLUGIN.md、plugin/README.md、experiments/README.md、SECURITY.md、GitHub Repo Metadata 與 LICENSE 唯讀核對。此 Repo 首次建立於 2026-10-13；主文件列出三個機制，但即時使用時 microskills 預設關閉、toolprune 與 loopguard 預設開啟。Micro-skills 由使用紀錄合成，Codex Plugin 中所附 Skills 主要是操作命令介面，不應因名稱含 Skill 就另行複製成獨立 Canonical Skill。官方數字為論文 Benchmark 結果，沒有在使用者環境或任何真實專案再現。未安裝、未呼叫模型、未修改 Agent 設定，也沒有在 Repo 執行測試。

source.summary: Read-only source research: benchmark metrics documented as upstream claims, not independently tested; original code not installed or run.
